_readme: Fill in every null under studio and payments. qa.js blocks all sending while any required field is null.

payments.rules: Invoices are created by you in PayPal and sent from PayPal. Never ask for card numbers, bank logins or passwords in any message.

settings._phpPerUSD: Set the rate you actually receive from PayPal so the goal total is accurate.
settings._pricing: Each prospect gets a tier from its complexity (simple / standard / menu). Set prospect.quote to override. Never quote below minQuoteUSD (or the market equivalent) without asking the owner.

US.notes: Every email needs your physical postal address and a working opt-out. No cold SMS to US numbers (TCPA risk).

CA.notes: Only emails the business publishes conspicuously, with no 'no solicitations' note, and the pitch must relate to their business.

AU.notes: Accurate sender and a working unsubscribe.

UK.notes: Cold email only to limited companies and LLPs, never sole traders or partnerships.

NZ.notes: NZ pricing was never set by you; NZD assumed.

netlify._note: Live since 2026-11-13. Redeploy after every build.js run that changes a demo.

_portfolio: Your 3 best demos, by slug. Swap in won client sites (with permission) as they launch.

tierLabels.simple: Simple one-page site: services, hours, map, click-to-call, contact form
tierLabels.standard: One-page site plus a photo gallery or booking link and a longer services list
tierLabels.menu: One-page site with a full menu, specials and catering or ordering info
